2047. Word Reverser Using PrintWriter

40

Medium

Problem Statement
Read a line of text and print it reversed using a PrintWriter stream.
Description
Use BufferedReader to read a line of text, reverse its characters, and use a PrintWriter, wrapping System.out, to print the reversed string.
input_spec: A single line containing a string, str (no spaces).
